recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy ensemble composition featuring six diverse young adults in mid-air celebratory poses, wearing bright red graduation gowns over formal attire. The subjects are arranged in a dynamic, radial cluster against a stark white background, creating a sense of weightless joy and achievement.
coreVisualRelationships: Uniformity of red robes against a neutral white void
Radial explosion of limbs and bodies from a central lower point
Contrast between formal graduation attire and athletic, expressive movement
Diagonal typographic alignment mirroring the upward momentum of the subjects
coreInvariants: Bright red graduation gowns with satin finish

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the upper two-thirds of the frame in a dense, overlapping cluster; scale is uniform to suggest an ensemble cast.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central male figure in a black tie serves as the vertical axis for the surrounding jumpers.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bottom-left typography, follow the diagonal line of the text upward, and then circulate through the expressive faces and limbs of the jumping group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central cluster, emphasizing the silhouette of the red robes.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy display sans-serif paired with a lighter, wider sans-serif for secondary metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio photograph of six diverse young adults in red graduation gowns jumping joyfully against a seamless white background. They should be holding diplomas and wearing formal clothes under the robes. The lighting should be bright and even with minimal shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, sans-serif title in the bottom right corner, tilted at a 30-degree upward angle. Use stacked uppercase words in black and red, featuring a very large red numeral integrated into the right side of the text block.
